newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-RAIN HITS LAST DAY OF WINDIES-INDIA TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN HITS LAST DAY OF WINDIES-INDIA TEST.

text.p: Persistent drizzle prevented any play before lunch on the fifth and final day of the first test between West Indies and India at Sabina Park on Monday.
With Jamaica's meteorological office predicting the damp, cloudy conditions to persist for most of the day, a draw now seems inevitable.
At the close of the fourth day, West Indies were 241 for four in their second innings, 322 ahead on a slow, low pitch.

West Indies captain Courtney Walsh will almost certainly declare the second innings closed whenever play becomes possible, to give his team an outside chance of forcing a victory in the opening match of the five-test series.
Overnight scores: West Indies 427 and 241-4, India 346.
